title: File upload with drop zone and progress
description: An upload control that works with a regular file button first and adds drag-and-drop as an enhancement: states accepted types and size limits up front, shows per-file progress, validation errors per file, retry and remove actions, and a final summary.
intent: Let users add files reliably, understand limits before they try, and recover from failed uploads per file.
characteristics: native file input as the base, drop zone as an enhancement
accepted types and max size stated before selection
per-file row with name, size, progress, and status
client-side checks repeated on the server
interaction: Clicking or pressing Enter on the zone opens the file picker; dropping highlights the zone; uploads start immediately or on submit (state which); cancelling an in-flight upload is possible.
responsive: Drop zone shrinks to a button on touch devices, where drag-and-drop is rarely available; file list stays a single column.
accessibility: Real button or label for the file input; progress uses progress elements with labels; status changes (done, failed) announced politely; error text per file linked to the row.
limitations: Large files need resumable or chunked uploads, which this spec does not cover.
Folder upload and paste-to-upload behave differently across browsers.
